scope: 0.9 strict-sequence step 3 (composite research fault regression): one fully successful improve-strategy composite journey plus the R1-R5 fault matrix on a synthetic user and an isolated stack. Maintenance/audit only.

authorization.note: Maintainer delegated develop/push/Draft PR for this 0.9 step; merge and any deploy remain the human gate.

non_goals: no production deploy or production data access
no Community repository inspection or copy
evidence_rule: Missing real evidence MUST be FAIL/BLOCKED. A health check, a declared result, a page or endpoint existence, or a unit fixture is never a PASS.

composite_journey.isolation: dedicated compose project + dedicated network/volumes + loopback-only ports + fresh synthetic PostgreSQL
must_prove: object lineage (every step links to the original task id)
original idempotency key preserved on the approved action
final comparison report consistent with the exact persisted jobs and terminal task state

fault_matrix.boundaries: R1-R5 defined boundaries (Gateway/adapter/worker, runtime lifecycle, approval and domain)

optional_rows.reason: a real host reboot is not authorized and is not equivalent to a container restart

acceptance_gates.requirement: The composite journey runs end-to-end at least once with every required step PASS and consistent lineage/owner/workspace/original-key/approval/identity/report.
Every required fault row is present and PASS with the six assertions, real before/after authoritative counts and no orphan.
The observer is fail-able and every negative control exits non-zero, including the defect-targeting controls.
The capture layer never defaults to success; every capture negative fails post-fix and passes pre-fix.
Isolated stack only; production untouched; cleanup leaves zero containers/networks/volumes.
No missing evidence is labeled PASS; failures are labeled FAIL/BLOCKED with a reason.
